"""The root of all... queries"""
type Query {
  """
  Get a list of products.
               Based on the REST API endpoint             https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html#get_products_uuid
  """
  products(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    Get all products that are in a children category of the specified ones.        Under the hood we use the <<IN CHILDREN>> operator, if you want another operator, you can use search instead this argument
    """
    categories: [String]

    """List separated by comma of attributes to get from the REST API."""
    attributesToLoad: [String]

    """
    Get all the products that belong to specified families into this list.        The list of families contains the code of the families, separated by comma.        Example: ["a_family","another_family"]
    """
    families: [String]

    """
    The channel to filter the results.        Example: "ecommerce"
    """
    channel: String

    """
    A list of currencies code to filter the results.        Example: ["EUR","USD"]
    """
    currencies: [String]

    """
    A list of uuid to filter the results.        Example: ["2ffe11e5-ebad-431d-a9ec-b1d1e3c28b13","e5fe922a-6253-4dd5-be96-aae8b11e9c8c"]
    """
    uuid: [String]

    """
    Get all variants of a specific parent.            Under the hood we use the <<equal>> operator.            If you want another operator, you can use search instead this argument.            More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html
    """
    parent: String

    """
    Return only products without parent if set to true.        If you want another operator, you can use search instead of this argument.        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html
    """
    noParent: NoParent

    """
    Convert values of measurement attributes to the unit configured in the channel provided by the parameter "channel".                     Therefore, this parameter requires the channel parameter to be provided.
    """
    convertMeasurements: Boolean
  ): ProductCollection

  """
  Get a list of product models.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Productmodel
  """
  productModels(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]

    """
    A list of currencies code to filter the results.        Example: ["EUR","USD"]
    """
    currencies: [String]

    """
    Get all products that are in a children category of the specified ones.        Under the hood we use the <<IN CHILDREN>> operator, if you want another operator, you can use search instead this argument
    """
    categories: [String]

    """List separated by comma of attributes to get from the REST API."""
    attributesToLoad: [String]

    """
    Get all the products that belong to specified families into this list.        The list of families contains the code of the families, separated by comma.        Example: ["a_family","another_family"]
    """
    families: [String]

    """
    The channel to filter the results.        Example: "ecommerce"
    """
    channel: String

    """
    Return only products without parent if set to true.        If you want another operator, you can use search instead of this argument.        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html
    """
    noParent: NoParent

    """
    Convert values of measurement attributes to the unit configured in the channel provided by the parameter "channel".                        Therefore, this parameter requires the channel parameter to be provided.
    """
    convertMeasurements: Boolean
  ): ProductModelCollection

  """
  Get a list of locales.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Locale
  """
  locales(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """Filter the results by enabled or disabled."""
    enabled: Boolean
  ): LocaleCollection

  """
  Get a list of families.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Family
  """
  families(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    If true, it will only return families with at least one product.            If false, it will only return families that have no products.
    """
    hasProducts: Boolean

    """
    Filter the families that have been updated after a certain date. The date should be in the ISO 8601 standard.
    """
    updatedAfter: String
  ): FamilyCollection

  """
  Get a list of categories.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Category
  """
  categories(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    When true, only returns categories that are root.        When false, returns any other categories.
    """
    root: Boolean

    """
    A parent you want to filter on.        Example: "parentCode"
    """
    parent: String

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]
  ): CategoryCollection

  """
  Get a list of attributes.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Attribute
  """
  attributes(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]

    """
    A list of attributes types to filter the results.        Example: ["pim_catalog_simpleselect","pim_catalog_multiselect"]
    """
    types: [String]

    """Get attributes defined as identifier."""
    identifier: Boolean
  ): AttributeCollection

  """
  Get a list of attribute groups.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html#Attributegroup
  """
  attributeGroups(
    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]
  ): AttributeGroupsCollection

  """
  Get a list of options of a given attribute.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html#Attributeoption
  """
  attributeOptions(
    """Attribute to filter on."""
    attributeCode: String!

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String
  ): AttributeOptionsCollection

  """
  Get the list of all currencies.            You can filter on the enabled status.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Currency
  """
  currencies(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """Filter the results by enabled or disabled."""
    enabled: Boolean
  ): CurrencyCollection

  """
  Get a list of measurement families.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Measurementfamily
  """
  measurementFamilies(
    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]
  ): MeasurementFamilyCollection

  """
  Get a list of channels.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Channel
  """
  channels(
    """Number of results, the maximum allowed is 10."""
    limit: Int

    """A page number, only integers are accepted."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]
  ): ChannelCollection

  """
  Get a list of asset families.            Based on the REST API endpoint             https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Assetfamily
  """
  assetFamilies(
    """Get the asset family that matches the given code."""
    code: String

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]
  ): AssetFamiliesCollection

  """
  Get a list of assets of a given asset family. Assets are paginated.            This endpoint is case sensitive on the asset family code.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Asset
  """
  assetsRecords(
    """Asset family to filter on."""
    assetFamily: String!

    """
    The channel to filter the results.        Example: "ecommerce"
    """
    channel: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]
  ): AssetFamiliesRecordsCollection

  """
  Get a list of reference entities.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Referenceentities
  """
  referenceEntities(
    """Get the reference entity that matches the given code."""
    code: String

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]
  ): ReferenceEntitiesCollection

  """
  Get a list of records of a given reference entity. Records are paginated and can be filtered.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#Referenceentityrecord
  """
  referenceEntitiesRecords(
    """Reference entity to filter on."""
    referenceEntity: String!

    """
    The channel to filter the results.        Example: "ecommerce"
    """
    channel: String

    """
    A list of locales code to filter the results.        Example: ["en_US","fr_FR"]
    """
    locales: [String]

    """An entity ID or code, used as a cursor."""
    page: String

    """
    A list of search filters to apply in JSON format.        Example: {"enabled":[{"operator":"=","value":true}]}        More information in the dedicated section of our REST API documentation: https://api.akeneo.com/documentation/filter.html         Warning: the "search" filter has not the priority over the other filters.        It means, for example, that if you use the "uuid" filter and the "search" filter on uuid, the second filter won't be taken into account.
    """
    search: JSON

    """
    A list of codes to filter the results.        Example: ["code1","code2"]
    """
    codes: [String]
  ): ReferenceEntityRecordsCollection

  """
  Get the version and the edition of the PIM.            Based on the REST API endpoint            https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html?#System
  """
  systemInformation: SystemInformation

  """
  Get an authentication token or refresh an expired token. No need to be authenticated to use this endpoint        Based on the REST API endpoint        https://api.akeneo.com/api-reference.html#Authentication
  """
  token(
    """Your PIM username"""
    username: String!

    """Your PIM password"""
    password: String!

    """Your PIM client id"""
    clientId: String!

    """Your PIM client secret"""
    clientSecret: String!

    """
    Use this token when your access token has expired. Must be used with username and password.
    """
    refreshToken: String
  ): Token
}

"""An Akeneo Product Collection"""
type ProductCollection {
  links: SearchLinks
  items: [Product]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

type SearchLinks {
  self: String
  next: String
}

"""An Akeneo Product"""
type Product implements ProductInterface {
  uuid: String
  enabled: String
  created: String
  updated: String
  qualityScore: [JSONObject]
  family: Family
  attributes: [Attribute]
  categories: [Category]
  attributeValues(
    """Attribute code from which we get the product attribute values."""
    code: String!
  ): [JSON]

  """Allow to retrieve a list of associated products and product models."""
  simpleAssociations: [SimpleAssociation] @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << associations >> that contains both associations and quantified associations.")

  """
  Allow to retrieve a list of associated products and product models with quantity.
  """
  quantifiedAssociations: [QuantifiedAssociation] @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << associations >> that contains both associations and quantified associations.")

  """
  Allow to retrieve a list of associations with their related products and productModels.
  """
  associations: [Association]
  parent: ProductModel
  variationValues: [JSON]
  completeness: [JSONObject]
}

"""An Akeneo Product Interface"""
interface ProductInterface {
  created: String
  updated: String
  qualityScore: [JSONObject]
  family: Family
  attributes: [Attribute]
  categories: [Category]
  attributeValues(
    """Attribute code from which we get the product attribute values."""
    code: String!
  ): [JSON]

  """Allow to retrieve a list of associated products and product models."""
  simpleAssociations: [SimpleAssociation] @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << associations >> that contains both associations and quantified associations.")

  """
  Allow to retrieve a list of associated products and product models with quantity.
  """
  quantifiedAssociations: [QuantifiedAssociation] @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << associations >> that contains both associations and quantified associations.")

  """
  Allow to retrieve a list of associations with their related products and productModels.
  """
  associations: [Association]
  parent: ProductModel
}

"""
The `JSONObject` scalar type represents JSON objects as specified by [ECMA-404](http://www.ecma-international.org/publications/files/ECMA-ST/ECMA-404.pdf).
"""
scalar JSONObject

"""An Akeneo Family"""
type Family {
  code: String
  attributes: [Attribute]
  attributeRequirements: [FamilyAttributeRequirements]
  labels: [JSONObject]
  attributeAsLabel: String
  attributeAsImage: String

  """
  The familyVariant is filled,                 with all available values when asked in the query families,                 with the linked one to the product model in the query productModels.                 On product query, it is empty.
  """
  familyVariant: [FamilyVariant]
}

"""An Akeneo Attribute"""
type Attribute {
  code: String
  type: String
  isMainIdentifier: Boolean

  """Reference entities and assets are RelatedObject in GraphQL application"""
  relatedObject: RelatedObject
  group: Group
  metricFamily: String
  sortOrder: Int
  numberMin: Int
  numberMax: Int
  decimalsAllowed: Boolean
  negativeAllowed: Boolean
  dateMin: String
  dateMax: String
  maxCharacters: Int
  minimumInputLength: Int
  defaultMetricUnit: String
  allowedExtensions: [String]
  maxFileSize: String
  tableConfiguration: [JSONObject]
  groupLabels: [JSONObject]
  availableLocales: [String]
  validationRule: String
  validationRegexp: String
  referenceDataName: String
  unique: Boolean
  valuePerLocale: Boolean
  valuePerChannel: Boolean
  isReadOnly: Boolean
  isMandatory: Boolean
  guidelines: [JSONObject]
  updated: String
  labels: [JSONObject]

  """
  The values of the attribute in the current context.                            If this field is queried within the attributes query it will return null.
  """
  values(
    """
    DEPRECATED: use nestedObjectValueLevel instead.                                  If true, the values will be fetched with the related object values.
    """
    withRelatedObjectValues: Boolean

    """
    The maximum level of nested object values to fetch.                                  Limited to 2.
    """
    nestedObjectValueLevel: Int
  ): [JSONObject]
}

"""
Information about the attribute's related object (asset or reference entity).
"""
type RelatedObject {
  """Related object code."""
  code: String

  """Related object label."""
  labels: [JSONObject]

  """
  If the related object is an asset, this field indicates the main media attribute.
  """
  attributeAsMainMedia: String

  """
  If the related object is an reference entity, this field indicates cover image.
  """
  image: String
}

"""An Akeneo Group"""
type Group {
  code: String
  sortOrder: Int
  attributes: [String]
  labels: [JSONObject]
}

"""An Akeneo Family AttributeRequirementsType"""
type FamilyAttributeRequirements {
  channelCode: String
  attributesRequirements: [String]
}

"""An Akeneo Family Variant"""
type FamilyVariant {
  code: String
  labels: [JSONObject]

  attributes: [String]

}

"""An Akeneo Category"""
type Category {

  parent: Category
  updated: String
  labels: [JSONObject]
  position: Int
  values: [JSONObject]
}

"""

"""
scalar JSON

"""An association object."""
type SimpleAssociation {

  products: [Product]
  productModels: [ProductModel]
}

type ProductModel implements ProductInterface {

  """
  quantifiedAssociations: [QuantifiedAssociation] @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << associations >> that contains both associations and quantified associations.")

  """
  Allow to retrieve a list of associations with their related products and productModels.
  """
  associations: [Association]
  parent: ProductModel
  enabled: String @deprecated(reason: "Will be removed as no << enabled >> field exist for models on the PIM")
  variationAxes: [String]
}

"""A quantified association object."""
type QuantifiedAssociation {
  type: String @deprecated(reason: "Replaced by the new field << code >>")
  code: String
  quantifiedProducts: [QuantifiedAssociationProduct]

}

"""A quantified product association object."""
type QuantifiedAssociationProduct {
  quantity: Int

}

"""A quantified product model association object."""
type QuantifiedAssociationProductModel {
  quantity: Int

"""An association object."""
type Association {
  code: String
  associatedProducts: [AssociationProduct]
  associatedProductModels: [AssociationProductModel]
  labels: [JSONObject]
}

"""An associated product."""
type AssociationProduct {
  quantity: Int
  product: Product
}

"""An associated product model."""
type AssociationProductModel {
  quantity: Int

}

"""Information about the current GraphQL query"""
type QueryInformation {
  """Complexity of the request"""
  requestComplexity: Int

  """the detail of the calculated complexity of the query"""
  requestComplexityDetail: JSONObject

  """Transaction ID of the current request"""
  transactionId: String

  """List of deprecated fields & arguments used in the current query"""
  deprecations: JSON
}

enum NoParent {
  YES
}

"""An Akeneo Product Models Collection"""
type ProductModelCollection {
  links: SearchLinks
  items: [ProductModel]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

"""An Akeneo Locale Collection"""
type LocaleCollection {
  links: PageLinks
  items: [Locale]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

  self: String
  next: String
  previous: String
}

type Locale {
  code: String

}

"""An Akeneo Family Collection"""
type FamilyCollection {
  links: PageLinks
  items: [Family]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

"""An Akeneo Category Collection"""
type CategoryCollection {
  links: PageLinks
  items: [Category]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

"""An Akeneo Attribute Collection"""
type AttributeCollection {
  links: PageLinks
  items: [Attribute]

  """Information about the current GraphQL query."""
  queryInformation: QueryInformation
}

"""An Akeneo Attribute Groups Collection"""
type AttributeGroupsCollection {
